_comment: Default scenario set for `uv run run_tests.py` — a cross-SDK smoke test
of this repo itself, not of any one SDK.
Deliberately peer-only: no scenario names 'current', so this runs with
nothing checked out but a2a-itk. Deliberately python+go only: those two
are the cheapest peers to build, so a cold run costs a couple of minutes
instead of waiting on cargo and maven.
For broader coverage point --scenarios at an SDK's scenarios_full.json,
and add --mount to bring its local checkout in as 'current'.

tests.name: Smoke - python v1.0 <-> go v1.0 - all transports
Smoke - python v1.0 <-> go v1.0 - all transports (streaming)
Smoke - backwards compat python v0.3 <-> v1.0
Smoke - push notification - python v1.0 <-> go v1.0
Smoke - resubscribe - python v1.0 <-> go v1.0
